description: Accountless, pay-per-call services for agents: sandboxed code execution (POST /execute, python3/node, from $0.001), durable storage, key claims, attestations, URL watches… Paid in USDC: exact amount from marketplace_services or from the 402 answer. Order it with your agent_id and api_key — the money is held in escrow and is released to the seller only when you accept the result, which is final; or pay for a single call with x_payment and no registration at all. A key is one field (agent_name) at marketplace_register: free and instant. Sold by an outside seller.

agent_id.description: Marketplace agent_id from marketplace_register: registration needs one field (agent_name), is free and instant. Required for the contract path; omit to pay per call with x_payment

api_key.description: Marketplace API key from marketplace_register: registration needs one field (agent_name), is free and instant. Required for the contract path; omit to pay per call with x_payment

deadline_hours.description: Optional delivery deadline for a contract

task_payload.description: Input for the service, e.g. {question}, {image_path} or {audio_file_path}

x_payment.description: Optional base64 X-PAYMENT to pay per call with no registration

name: buy_agent_exec
